4: A System, much like a Language, does not inherently contain meaning. This means, that a System will not tell the Engineer which part is more important than the next, or why systems connect in such a way (the atlas or story of a system) Meaning is not a projection; it is an essential anchor in Entropy Episteme space. What is meaning? It is the translation, transaction, exchange from -emitter-system(processor)-reciever

Principle: A system must require Objective, Direction or Hypothesis. 

A Hypothesis is forged when the story of a System converges onto a known problem boundary and an actionable, observable prediction model. These are the components of a Hypothesis.

The story is the necessary model for an Abstract hypothesis to converge.
